question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
delta_reason: RESOLVED YES 2026-06-15. Qatari mediator Ali Al-Thawadi convened a formally named session with Iranian FM Araghchi on the night of June 13-14. Iranian Deputy FM Kazem Gharibabadi confirmed via Tasnim News Agency, IRIB, and IRNA on June 15 that the US-Iran MOU has been finalized. Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif publicly confirmed. Nine TIER1 sources confirm. All YES-criteria met: named mediating country (Qatar), named Iranian principal (Araghchi), official Iranian state-media statement (Gharibabadi via Tasnim/IRIB) rescinding the June 1 suspension.
resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension.
resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

question: Will a TIER1-confirmed convened US-Iran negotiating session occur before EOD 2026-06-24?
delta_reason: RESOLVED YES 2026-06-15. Same Qatari-mediated session (Al-Thawadi with Araghchi, night of June 13-14) satisfies F2 criteria of a TIER1-confirmed formally convened indirect session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys hosted by a named mediator (Qatar). CNN, NBC, CBS, France 24, Times of Israel, and Gharibabadi via Tasnim all confirm. Iran MFA statement via Gharibabadi explicitly lifts the June 1 suspension.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar), between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Axios/Al Jazeera/Times of Israel; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also qualifies.
